selected_protocol.output_policy: Use a new root and one unique results subdirectory per new repeat; do not reuse or overwrite any prior evaluation directory.

interpretation_limits: Five repeats at one initialization are a fixed-condition repeatability check, not a generalization estimate.
A 5/5 versus 4/5 difference at one initialization is not by itself a reliable model-performance difference.
The existing paired 20-initialization comparison remains the broader matched-seed comparison; this follow-up only audits repeatability at init3.
